context: A Glamour viewer component that adapts to the terminal from inside a running program

checklist.name: background_from_message
checklist.description: Gets light or dark from `tea.RequestBackgroundColor` (returned from `Init`) and `tea.BackgroundColorMsg.IsDark()`, and passes `WithStandardStyle("dark")` or `"light"` explicitly to the renderer.

checklist.name: no_terminal_query
checklist.description: Does not call `lipgloss.HasDarkBackground(os.Stdin, os.Stdout)` or otherwise query the terminal from the component or from inside the running program.

checklist.name: rerender_either_order
checklist.description: Re-renders in both the `BackgroundColorMsg` handler and the `WindowSizeMsg` handler, because the two messages arrive in either order; rendering only on resize leaves a dark terminal with the light (or default) style until the next resize.

checklist.name: wrap_follows_width
checklist.description: Builds the renderer with `WithWordWrap` from the current window width (clamped to a positive minimum) and renders again on resize, instead of a fixed wrap such as 80.

checklist.name: viewport_content
checklist.description: Hands the rendered string to `viewport.SetContent` and sizes the viewport from `WindowSizeMsg`.
